BiblicalUsage: zâqun means old age. In Genesis 21:2 we read, "For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him." It appears again in Genesis 21:7: "And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham..."
TheologicalSignificance: zaqun is old age, and it leaves me trusting that God's words are never empty.
